chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Isa ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Ja'far, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:

When the fifth one of the descendants of the seventh is missed, then take care of your religions; let nothing turn you aside from it, for the executor of this matter must undergo an occultation until many of those who believed in him will apostate. It is merely a trial from Allah by which Allah tests His creation. If your fathers and grandfathers had found a religion more authentic than this, they would have followed it. I said: 'O my master, who is the fifth of the seventh's descendants?' He said: 'O my son, your minds are too small to perceive this and your patience is too weak to bear it, but if you live, you will come to know him.'

key_terms.صَاحِب الْأَمْر: The executor of the matter (Imam al-Qa'im)

ai.seo_question: Who is the fifth descendant of the seventh Imam and what is the significance of his occultation?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (as) identifies the fifth descendant of the seventh Imam (Imam al-Hadi) as the one whose occultation will serve as a divine trial (*mahnah*) causing many to abandon their faith. He emphasizes the stability of the current Twelver doctrine, noting that if a superior path existed, the forefathers would have followed it, and he cryptically notes that the specific identity will be clear to those who live long enough to witness it.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (11) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob al-Kulayni narrated from Ali bin Muhammad from al-Hasan bin Eessa bin Muhammad bin Ali bin Ja’far from his father from his grandfather from Ali bin Ja’far that his brother Imam Musa bin Ja’far (al-Kadhim) (as) had said:

“If the fifth one of the descendants of the seventh one is missed then you are to keep fast to your religion and let nothing turn you aside from it because the executor (al-Qa’im) of this task (reviving the religion) must disappear until many of those, who have believed in him, will apostate. It will be a test, by which Allah will try His people. If your fathers and grandfathers had found a religion better than this, they would have followed it.” I said: “O my master, who is the fifth of the seventh’s descendants?” He said: “O my son, your minds are smaller than to perceive this matter and your patience is weaker than to bear it. If you live until then, you will know who he is.”
